grc:other:Γ.gloss: The letter gamma (γάμμα), the third letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.

grc:other:γ.html:
γ, third letter in Gr. alphabet; as Numeral γ́=
three, third, thrice: also, with pr. n., Βάσσος γ́B., son and grandson of B., (ii A. D.), etc.: but <νυμ τειφορμ͂"νυμ">γ'<ν́υμ>= ,
written for ϝ, freq. in , as γανδάνειν: ἀρέσκειν, etc.
